item.title: Tranmere Rovers Women 0 Crewe Alexandra Women 1 | Match Report
item.description: Rovers exited the Cheshire Cup at the Quarter Final stage following defeat in a tight encounter. Both Tranmere and the visitors Crewe entered the Cheshire County Cup at the Quarter Finals stage and had their eyes on a cup run. Tranmere started brightly with Ashleigh Bullock latching onto a loose ball at the back from the visitors before seeing her low shot saved by Crewe keeper Hannah Holloway. item.title: Newport County 3-1 Tranmere Rovers | Match Report
item.description: Full-time: Newport County 3-1 Tranmere Rovers Rovers started on the front foot with Zech Obiero, playing as the most advanced central midfielder, winning a corner kick. From the set play, the ball came out to Sam Finley, who found the far bottom-left corner with a scissor kick for a third-minute lead. item.title: Club Statement - Andy Crosby
item.description: Tranmere Rovers can confirm that Andy Crosby has been relieved of his duties as first team manager with immediate effect. Chairman Mark Palios said: “Andy did a great job for us last year and has undoubtedly been dealt a tough hand this season with the exceptionally high level of injuries we have experienced. item.description: This International Women’s Day, Tranmere Rovers in the Community is proud to highlight the work of Mary Fitzgerald, whose dedication to youth development, sport, and community outreach continues to make a meaningful impact across the local area.
